﴿Lā aʿbudu﴾ (I do not worship) at present ﴿mā taʿbudūna﴾ (what you worship) of the idols.

Translation:

﴿And you are not worshipping what I worship﴾ at present, [that is,] Allah, the Exalted, alone.
﴿And I am not a worshipper﴾ in the future tense (al-istiqbal) ﴿of what you worship﴾ الِاسْتِقْبال

﴿ولا أنْتُمْ عابِدُونَ﴾ [nor are you going to worship] in the future tense (al-istiqbal), ﴿ما أعْبُد﴾ [what I worship]. God knew of them that they would not believe. The use of "ma" (what) for God is in the manner of antithesis (al-muqabalah).

For you is your religion (ﷻ), i.e., polytheism (al-shirk), and for me is my religion, i.e., Islam. This was before he was commanded to fight (bil-harb). The seven readers (al-qurra' al-sab'a) omitted the ya' of possession (ya' al-idafa) both in pausal and continuous recitation, while Ya'qub (Yaʿqub) retained it in both states.
